LanguageData.VFEI2_RoyalMegaspider.description: Not actually a spider, the royal megaspider is a naturally-evolved insectoid the size of an elephant. Its thick chitin armor and a pair of strong ripper-blades makes it a perfect designated primary hive defender and hunter. Unlike their bioengineered cousins, these insectoids have been created by the hive leaders to protect the most important hives, and their genetic composition and evolution path are a mystery to scientists.
